main_text.p: pius impofitum quidam laudant.Alij uerò cynoglofsi herbam lapide tritam: dein fu-perpofitam tribus horis carbunculum ex-tinguere præfenti remedio fcriptū reliquerunt.Pari modo & fcabiofa,& fymphytum minus pinfita & impofita,idem facere creduntur. Verùm fcabiofam addito nitro,ac fuilla axungia recenti diuino quodā præfidio carbunculum difcutere fertur. Item ficum aridam cum iride & fale tritam ,addita aloe hepatite carbunculū aperire aiunt. Idem quoq; de fermèto ex oleo , fale adiecto,prædicant:ut & de pane tosto , qui fer-uenti oleo intinctus eft,& impofitus. Circa carbunculos,ne ferpant,plantaginis folia fæpe impofita:aut panis aceto non acer rimo madens,plurimùm poffe dicuntur.

Aiunt recetiores quidam feminis gofsipij nucleos,& nuces peruetereṡ,cum fermenti pondere pari carbunculos aperire, & uirus allicere.Aliud eft quoq;,quod panos & carbunculos aperire fertur. Habet autem ficum pingue,iridem trita & calcem. Vlcera demũ implet & deterget, radix peucedani, alphodeli, fymphyti maioris trita,& iniecta: ficuti & farcocolla ex melle. Carbunculis uenenatis citreũ malum diuifum, addita

page.notes: Catchword "addita" is printed at the lower right; it is repeated as the first word of the next page and is kept here as printed. Small reference mark (asterisk-like) in the left margin below the text, not a note. Printed "peruetereṡ" is transcribed as printed with a long-s-like form; "quoq;," has a stray comma as printed. Three ink blots/specks on the lower left are not text and are omitted. The text is in a Latin printed hand with Gothic-style spelling; no black letter or Greek is present. Bottom-right of the printed line "malum diuifum," is slightly faded.
